checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals image-prompting, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals image-prompting; description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: Prompts are written in English and describe text-free images with a no-text, no-Arabic-script negative instruction.
checks.rule: Each prompt is English, states the image is text-free, and includes a negative instruction barring text and Arabic script.

checks.description: No Arabic text is ever baked into a generated image; copy arrives as overlay in stream 4.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid baked Arabic and state copy-overlay slots stay empty for copywriter-ar.

checks.description: Each asset brief specifies dimensions per placement and the safe areas.
checks.rule: asset_briefs include dimensions and safe areas for every placement.

checks.description: Copy-overlay slots are named and left empty, bound later to copy-package variant ids.
checks.rule: asset_briefs define named copy-overlay slots that are empty and reserved for stream 4 copy.

checks.description: Notes the designer executes visuals, runs design-qa, and keeps a human design check on Arabic.
checks.rule: Body states the designer executes generation, runs design-qa, and keeps a human design check on any Arabic.

checks.description: No invented dimensions, placements, Skill Path titles, instructor names, offers, or prices; missing means stop and ask.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid invented values and require stop-and-ask on a missing variable.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash glyph, no tatweel (U+0640), and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).

checks.description: Output populates the prompts[] and asset_briefs[] fields of the creative-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the prompts[] and asset_briefs[] fields of the creative-package per handoff-contract.md.
